artworks.title: A Grotesque with Diana of Ephesus and Diverse Animals
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 42.2 x 16.8 cm (16 5/8 x 6 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a central figure surrounded by two human-like entities with wings, a structure above the central figure supported by two bird-like creatures, two stags with impressive antlers on either side of the central figure, and a creature with features of a dog and a bird in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Veil of Saint Veronica
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Plattemontagne after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 45.5 x 35.3 cm (17 15/16 x 13 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man's face, depicted with long, wavy hair flowing past his shoulders. He has a serene expression, wide eyes looking directly at the viewer, a straight nose, and a slightly parted mouth. He has a neatly trimmed beard. The face has droplets of sweat or tears on the forehead and cheeks. It is imprinted on a piece of cloth tightly hung on a frame with a wreath of thorns below. The background is simple fabric within a rectangular border, presented in sepia tone.

artworks.title: The Body of Christ
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Plattemontagne after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure lying horizontally on his back with his hands crossed over his midsection. His head is slightly elevated on a pillow or fabric, and his eyes are closed. He has long wavy hair, and a cloth is draped around his waist. There are marks on his hands and feet, and draped linens and a crown of thorns are nearby. The setting is a stone-like enclosure with a carved inscription.

artworks.title: Harvesting
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite with scratching-out and touches of gum arabic on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Brown Foundation, Inc., Houston
artworks.description: The image displays a rural landscape from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high in the image, showing distant hills and fields under a dramatic sky with clouds. Sunlight breaks through the clouds, illuminating the landscape. In the foreground, figures are harvesting around a hay wagon. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the trees and light. The color palette includes browns, greens, golds, blues, and grays. A tree with slender branches frames the scene on the right.

artworks.title: The Head of Ullswater
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a wide landscape from an elevated point. The horizon is high up, with rolling hills, distant mountains, and a sky with light clouds. In the foreground, there are rocky terrain and a valley with trees and vegetation. The brushstrokes are textured but restrained, creating a serene appearance. The color scheme includes earth tones and soft grays, with the sky in pale blues and whites.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1722: The Temple of Janus
artworks.artist: Giovanni Girolamo Frezza after Alessandro Specchi (architect)
artworks.description: The image features a detailed line drawing of an urban scene from an elevated perspective, showing a large, bustling piazza with various people. Grand buildings line the horizon, with a neoclassical structure in the center. The precise and detailed brushstrokes create realistic architectural details and figures. The monochromatic sepia color palette highlights the intricate line work. People, including soldiers and elegantly dressed individuals, occupy the space. Stately buildings in the distance add depth, while the cloudy sky above contrasts with the structured elements below.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1755: A Triumphal Bridge with Antiquities from Herculaneum
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural scene with an arched bridge and elaborate sculptures. The scene features a grand, monumental structure with an arched bridge leading to a stately building adorned with columns, statues, and intricate designs, topped by a figure holding a staff or flag. Columns with statues of riders on elephants flank the bridge's entrance. A water body is depicted under the bridge with small boats and figures. The sky has wisps of clouds, giving a dramatic backdrop to the architectural showcase.

artworks.title: The Seconda Macchina for the Chinea of 1755: A Royal Hunting Lodge
artworks.description: The image shows an elaborate architectural structure with multiple columns, decorative elements, figures in various activities, a central ornate section with windows and sculptures, a dramatic plume-like feature on the roof, water fountains with statues on the sides, a low horizon line, and a monochromatic scheme with detailed line work. The background features a sky with cloud forms.

artworks.title: The Prima Macchina for the Chinea of 1757: The Colonnade of the Athenian Lyceum
artworks.artist: Giuseppe Pozzi after Giuseppe Palazzi (designer) and Paolo Posi (architect)
artworks.description: The image depicts an architectural structure resembling a grand portico or facade from a frontal viewpoint. The structure features symmetrical columns and sculptural details, with fine, detailed lines and cross-hatching in an engraving technique. Sculptures and urns adorn the roof, and various figures are present in the lower section. In the background are large statues against a textured sky filled with stylized clouds.

artworks.title: The Mountain Nymph, Sweet Liberty
artworks.description: The head and shoulders of a young woman with pale skin and long hair nearly fill this vertical, sepia-toned photograph. Shown against a dark background, she looks directly at us. Her nose is straight and her lips closed. Wavy curls piled over her forehead suggest that her hair is partially pulled back or pinned up around her oval face, and it falls behind her shoulders. Her garment has wide lapels and is worn over patterned clothing.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Child
artworks.description: The image depicts a young child lying on their side. The child is positioned on their right side with their head resting on their left hand, while the other hand lies on their lap. The child has short, light-colored hair and closed eyes. They are wearing a knee-length dress with puffed sleeves and a lace collar. A broad-brimmed straw hat with a light-colored band is placed nearby. The scene includes potted plants on both sides of the child, and behind them, there is a stone or cement balustrade. The image is framed in an ornate, gold-colored border.

artworks.title: Derwentwater
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a body of water, a shoreline with trees, hills, and a sky in the background. The scene is monochromatic with sepia tones, giving it a timeless quality. The color palette is warm with light brown and beige hues. The image resembles an early photograph rather than a painting.

artworks.title: The Three Sleepers: Sophia Finlay, Harriet Farnie and Brownie
artworks.artist: David Octavius Hill and Robert Adamson
artworks.description: The image shows two children, both visible from the waist up. The child on the left sits with one arm resting on the piece of furniture behind them, eyes closed and head slightly tilted, with long, straight hair parted in the middle. They wear a garment with fringed detailing along the arms. The child on the right is lying with their head resting on their arms, eyes closed, with hair that appears to be similarly parted and straight. This child is dressed in plaid with a collar visible at the neckline. Around them, there is a piece of furniture draped with richly textured fabric adorned with tassels. The background seems to be blurred, focusing attention on the children.

artworks.title: The Boulevards of Paris
artworks.description: We look across a street at the façade of a five-story building with a pitched roof in this square sepia-toned photograph. Vertical rectangular windows are spaced along the lowest two levels of the building, which appears to be constructed with large rectangular stones. There is a squat, arched window over a dark opening at the bottom center. The façade of the next two stories is smooth. Tall, narrow arched windows line the third story, and the fourth story has smaller rectangular windows with shutters. Columns frame the central bank of windows in the third and fourth stories. Dormers of the fifth level protrude from the low pitched roof, which nearly reaches the top edge of the photograph. Another house is visible through a narrow alleyway to our right, and another shorter house is cropped by the right edge. Some details of the three horse-drawn carriages lining the street in front of the houses are blurry. The image is surrounded by a wide black band with uneven edges.

artworks.title: Erard de la Marck
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 34 x 24.5 cm (13 3/8 x 9 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The illustration depicts a man's head and shoulders. He faces forward with a serious expression, showcasing prominent facial features like a strong brow, pronounced cheekbones, and deep-set eyes. He has short hair. The man wears a hat, likely a biretta, associated with clergy, and a fur-lined cloak or robe. There are no visible accessories. The background features a crosshatched pattern, with Latin text and decorative embellishments below the portrait.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Mordecai
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed close to plate mark): 17.2 x 21.3 cm (6 3/4 x 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a ceremonial figure on horseback surrounded by a crowd. The person on the horse is adorned in elaborate attire, accompanied by a throng of people displaying various gestures. The crowd is densely packed, with a variety of expressions and poses. The background includes architectural elements like arches and columns. The detailed line work and shading create depth and texture in the image.

artworks.title: Virgin and Child in the Clouds
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman holding a child, both visible from the waist up. The woman is shown in a sitting position, cradling the child in her arms. Her face is softly sketched with a gentle expression. She is wearing flowing robes with intricate details, and her hair is mostly covered by a draped hood. The child is wrapped in a swaddling cloth and is close to the woman. The background is composed of hatched lines radiating outwards with faint outlines resembling clouds or abstract shapes.

artworks.title: Old Man Shading His Eyes with His Hand
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body and head of a person in a seated position, with their head tilted back and covered by their arm. The person appears to have long hair or a hat that blends with the fur-like texture drawn on their shoulder. They are wearing a garment with a textured detail around the shoulder area. The person's hand is resting on their head, and the lines highlight the furrowed detail of the hand. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the central figure with minimal distractions.

artworks.title: God the Father and Angels Adoring the Madonna and Child [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk on buff oatmeal paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kate Ganz in memory of Victor and Sally Ganz
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures in a dramatic composition. The figures are arranged in a monochromatic palette of browns and grays. One figure in flowing robes is seated in the lower left against swirling clouds or smoke. Another figure with wings is depicted in the upper right, suggesting movement through the air. The artwork has an expressive quality with flowing lines and a sense of movement and emotion conveyed by the figures and environment. The style and execution indicate the artist is skilled in capturing dynamic scenes with drama and movement.

artworks.title: Sketch for the Flight into Egypt [verso]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kate Ganz in memory of Victor and Sally Ganz
artworks.description: The image shows faint, swirling lines and curves across a lightly stained background. The shapes suggest movement of ribbons or loose threads, creating a sense of fluidity. The lines intermingle in a random fashion, resembling delicate tendrils or winding paths. The overall effect conveys subtlety and the interaction of ethereal forms on the paper.

artworks.title: Bathers
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Werner H. and Sarah-Ann Kramarsky
artworks.description: This painting depicts a group of nude figures bathing near a tree-lined body of water. The figures are depicted in a soft, flowing style with a pale color palette, creating a serene atmosphere. The background shows an abstracted landscape with hills and foliage rendered through loose brushwork. The style is reminiscent of Paul Cézanne, focusing on form and subtle use of color and light to convey depth and volume.

artworks.title: Gondolas
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Bequest of Lore Heinemann in memory of her husband, Dr. Rudolf J. Heinemann
artworks.description: The image shows several small boats on a body of water stretching across the middle of the scene. The horizon is not distinctly marked. The artwork is rendered in a loose and fluid style with quick, expressive brushstrokes capturing the boat forms and passengers. The color palette is monochromatic with earthy browns against a pale background. Figures are depicted working their oars, with a sketchy style conveying motion and activity. Additional boats with figures are seen beyond them, creating a sense of depth and spatial configuration.

artworks.title: Ignis
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over red chalk with gray and brown wash and white heightening on pink tinted paper, with pin pricks throughout the figure
artworks.description: The image shows a nude male figure standing in a dynamic pose. The man has his left arm extended upwards, holding a stick or scepter, and his right hand holding a spherical object emitting light. His head is turned slightly to his right, and his hair is windblown. The figure has defined facial features with a strong jawline, a straight nose, and high cheekbones. Over his shoulders, there is a flowing piece of cloth that billows behind him. In the background, there is a lion beside the man, a swirl of smoke or mist at his feet, and a faint line of human figures in the distance. The setting is in shades of brown ink and wash, creating an antique feel.

artworks.title: Allegorical Figure with a Cat and a Pig
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mark Borghi in honor of Angelo and Marie Guarino
artworks.description: The image is an ink drawing of a person standing in a relaxed posture. The figure faces forward with one arm resting on the side and the other raised, lightly touching their head. The face has classical proportions, with a straight nose and full lips, and the hair is depicted in curls. The body is mostly uncovered, with only hints of draped clothing around the shoulders. The person holds a cluster of foliage or a garland in one hand. The background includes architectural elements like a pillar and archway, with the area around the figure outlined with hatching for shadow and depth.
